bubbles.hello: Two formats, six concept frames. Each one shows what pulls attention and why, built from the feed we grew together.
bubbles.idea1: The second frame is your own red flat lay, used as a video cover. I would shoot that one first.
bubbles.idea2: Five cuts, five words, one sentence. People stay to finish the sentence. It is one of several Reel mechanics that work right now.

brand.grid_note: Your feed today: red flat lays with hand-written dish names, hand-lettered red lines over photos, polaroid collages for events. The concepts below use this language, not a new one.

ideas.label: Single-Scene Hook, phone version
ideas.idea: One plate, one take, one line. Steak frites, filmed at the table by a guest.

concepts.title: The line in your own handwriting
concepts.mechanism: A short line in your red script makes a plain phone shot instantly yours. One idea, read in under a second, arrow to the thing that matters.
concepts.proof: A London bistro's own account: one still phone camera over a table, one line of text. 35,400 likes.

concepts.title: Your red flat lay as the Reel cover
concepts.mechanism: Labels turn a dish into a map. The eye jumps between the labels, the red-and-white contrast stops the scroll, the voice stays playful.
concepts.proof: Big words over food in a café reel: 4,900 likes. Your own 'steak frites, encore.' post already uses this language.

concepts.title: Two stories in one frame
concepts.mechanism: The plate in front, a regular arriving on a scooter behind. Two things happen at once, so the eye keeps moving and the viewer stays.
concepts.proof: A fashion brand's reel: rider in front, a second action behind. Same trick, one scene.

ideas.label: Fast-Cut Story, one big word per cut
ideas.idea: Brunch in five cuts, no speech. One big word on each cut. Together they make one sentence: BRUNCH · IN · PERERENAN · FROM · 9AM.

concepts.title: BRUNCH
concepts.mechanism: One word per cut: the word is the hook, the food is the proof. Reads at any size, even muted.
concepts.proof: Café reel with one big word per frame: 4,900 likes.

concepts.title: PERERENAN
concepts.mechanism: The sentence builds across the cuts, so people watch to the end to complete it.
concepts.proof: A pour into a branded cup, café's own objects in frame: 3,000 likes.

concepts.title: FROM 9AM
concepts.mechanism: The last word lands on your sign. The venue itself closes the sentence and proves it is real.
concepts.proof: A café's 'Breakfast everyday 8–12' title block over a pour: 495 likes, a venue account.
